name: sign-pops-off
comment: WP-1.8 BlockSign.onNeighborBlockChange: a wall sign (68) with metadata 2 at (0,61,0) on a stone at (0,61,1), a wall sign with metadata 5 at (-3,61,0) on a stone at (-4,61,0), a sign post (63) at (3,61,3) on the platform, and a wall sign with metadata 0 (never supported) at (-3,61,3) on nothing. Their supports are removed with set_block air at t=2, t=4 and t=6; at t=8 a stone set next to the metadata-0 sign makes it check and drop. Each drop is Block.dropBlockAsItem (World.rand, an EntityItem of Item.sign 323, Math.random) then air (BlockContainer.onBlockRemoval removes the TileEntitySign). rng_state every tick, entity_state every 2, block_box at the end.
